Equation (5) represents the ideal gas equation for one mole of an ideal gas.
Here R is known as the molar gas constant or universal gas constant, and its value depends on
the nature and mass of the given gas. The value of R is 8.31J mol–1K–1. Since R is defined for
one mole of gas, it is called a molar gas constant. Also, the value of R is the same for all gases
which is called the universal gas constant.

Physical meaning of R
PV From relation R = nT , PV represents work done to change the temperature. Therefore. R
represents the work done to change the temperature of 1 mole of gas through 1 Kelvin. This is
a proportionality constant, which relates the energy scale to the temperature scale.
